review_fixes: Command::Sleep added to the protocol; BrowserView::retire_live/Lost/start-failure release the local live slot so the 8-live cap no longer ratchets after sleep (harness + browser_dock tests)
BrowserView::wake books the live slot only after host paths and profile directory are verified
open_url_from_terminal refuses a terminal without an owning session instead of routing to the active session
set_visible(false) cancels the IME composition on the host, not only locally

Host vulkan.rs: frame copy uses vkCmdCopyImage instead of vkCmdBlitImage; on NVIDIA 610.57 the 3D-class blit faulted (Xid 69) for viewport widths not multiple of 32 px (880, 1000) with block-linear CEF frames, killing the host with ERROR_DEVICE_LOST; the copy engine has no such constraint and the blit never scaled. Verified with the prototype at 880x1034, 1000x700, 1280x800, 1088x608 (input/resize/scale steps), host unit round trip test, clippy cef-runtime
Host presentation.rs: removed a redundant u32 cast that failed clippy under --features cef-runtime (never linted by the workspace gate)

Host linux.rs: the control reader posted at most one message per 10 ms (PollControl processed a single try_recv, reader channel of 4). Mouse-move floods and per-pixel Present commands during a dock resize backed the pipe up until the app's 256-slot outbound channel filled and FrameAcknowledger::ack failed with Busy (fatal 'GPU acknowledgement not delivered: Busy'). PollControl now drains every queued message, the reader thread wakes the UI thread per message, and the reader channel holds 256

App page.rs: present_if_needed coalesces visible resizes: at most one resize in flight until a frame follows it (250 ms settle timeout as a safety net) and none while the previous pool is still retiring; hidden and show transitions bypass the gate (unit tests on resize_may_be_sent). Mirrors libcef's own one-in-flight resize hold (CefRenderWidgetHostViewOSR::WasResized/ReleaseResizeHold)
App view.rs: on_gpu_completion success now notifies the view so the released old-pool frame is redrawn and released promptly

Host presentation.rs: a paint that needs a third pool no longer marks the active pool retiring (it starts a 1 s RetireCheck on a pool the app still displays); the paint is dropped, pool_starved is set, and a refresh is posted when the retiring pool drains

Host presentation.rs: root cause of the intermittent RetireTimeout on resize: the single CefBrowserHost::Invalidate posted 20 ms after PoolReady is sometimes ignored by the viz capturer, so the new pool never painted while the old one waited on its 1 s deadline. RefreshTask now retries every 50 ms (16 retries) until the active pool has painted. Prototype: 20/20 runs COMPLETED at 880x1034, 1000x700, 1280x800, 1088x608 (input, resize, scale); 3 runs show the retry recovering (65 to 72 ms to the first frame instead of 21 ms); before the fix 1/9 and 2/9 failed

Host presentation.rs: ime_set_composition and ime_commit_text passed a null replacement_range; the CEF C API marks only text and underlines optional, so the official runtime silently dropped every IME commit and the DCHECK-enabled patched runtime aborted the host on the first keystroke (GPUI on Wayland commits typed text through the IME path). Both calls now pass CefRange::InvalidRange (u32::MAX, u32::MAX) as cefclient does (osr_window_win.cc:401)
Final closure: collapse two nested conditions in Browser page metrics, initialize IME test state directly, apply cargo fmt.

stories.title: Récupérer crashes et arrêts sans toucher aux terminaux

evidence.requirement: Crash renderer et crash host sont distingués ; seules les pages concernées deviennent Crashed et toutes leurs generations/opérations sont invalidées.
evidence.entry_point: CEF renderer callback -> versioned Crashed; supervisor host loss -> owned profile pages
evidence.proof: Renderer generation invalidation and profile routing tests; earlier native host crash preserved terminals and required explicit wake.

evidence.requirement: Le nettoyage arrête uniquement les descendants possédés par le host dans le délai NFR-08 et libère les ressources selon les fences.
evidence.entry_point: App shutdown -> HostSupervisor owned process group; page release -> GPU completion -> ACK
evidence.proof: shutdown_reaps_every_descendant_of_the_host exercises real descendants; fence/retirement deadline tests; cleanup-review.json records current native close. Full matrix NFR budgets remain EP-005. Review fix: shutdown_schedule bounds the close wait, SIGTERM and SIGKILL windows inside SHUTDOWN_GRACE; the_shutdown_schedule_never_exceeds_the_stop_budget plus the tightened shutdown_reaps_every_descendant_of_the_host assertion.

evidence.requirement: La relance est explicite, restaure une URL admissible et ne rejoue ni mutation agent ni POST ; le parent ne fait pas d’I/O bloquante.
evidence.entry_point: Human Reload -> validated URL -> background host activation -> Created flush
evidence.proof: Native explicit wake restored fixture; startup URL coalescing regression passes; no automatic restart or POST replay.

evidence.requirement: Échec : arrêt incomplet, fence bloquée ou événement tardif produit une erreur bornée sans libération GPU prématurée, kill global ou boucle de reprise infinie.
evidence.entry_point: Host timeout/poison/late event -> bounded failure; GPU fence retirement contract
evidence.proof: Final supervisor, frame ledger and deadline suites cover no restart, stale ACK and retained resources. Native GPU stall injection is not claimed.

stories.review_note: AC-2 corrected during review: the stop sequence now fits inside the NFR-08 five-second budget (supervisor.rs shutdown_schedule/reap_group). Native timing on the release matrix stays with EP-005.

stories.title: Appliquer origines, certificats et permissions

evidence.proof: tls-policy-advanced-final.png and tls-policy-advanced-atspi.txt: no Proceed; tls3-resumed.log no request. Local HTTP works; URL scheme and permission masks tested.

evidence.requirement: Chaque demande est liée à l’origine, au profil et au document ; navigation, révocation ou fermeture invalide toute réponse tardive.
evidence.entry_point: Origin/profile/document pending callback -> scoped human WebResponse
evidence.proof: actual_callbacks_reject_stale_revoked_closed_and_unknown_requests uses actual CEF callback objects; microphone-prompt-current.png.

evidence.requirement: Caméra/micro, géolocalisation et clipboard asynchrone suivent les autorisations de session et les protections OS Linux qualifiées ; les capacités v1 exclues restent refusées.
evidence.entry_point: CEF media/permission callbacks and renderer async clipboard -> session grant -> OS backend
evidence.proof: microphone-result.png confirms allowed microphone; fixture stops tracks immediately. Native deny plus supported/excluded mask, clipboard and missing-backend rejection coverage; broad OS matrix remains EP-005.

evidence.requirement: Les pages ne reçoivent ni bridge natif ni accès au canal privé ; les dialogues montrent l’origine et les diagnostics exportés sont réduits.
evidence.entry_point: Origin-visible web dialog; private inspector capability checked on renderer and host
evidence.proof: Native origin dialogs; trusted_url_alone_never_grants_the_inspector_capability and bounded bridge tests. Ordinary pages have no native capability; drop traces contain no paths.

evidence.requirement: Échec : changement d’origine, refus système ou absence de backend n’accorde aucun droit par défaut et ne désactive pas les protections du moteur.
evidence.entry_point: Unknown/excluded/stale/revoked callback -> deny, OS backend authoritative
evidence.proof: Actual callback rejection suite and native microphone denial; TLS hard refusal retains engine protections.

stories.title: Brancher dialogues, popups et transferts de fichiers

evidence.proof: Native alert/confirm/prompt/beforeunload artifacts, fixed2-popup-selected.png and shared profile persistence; concurrent/stale dialog tests. window.opener relation is not preserved.

evidence.requirement: Upload, drag de fichiers et destinations de download passent par une sélection humaine OS ; progression et annulation sont visibles.

evidence.proof: upload-selected-complete.png; file-drop-ack-result.png and events-drop-ack-final.jsonl show file received; download-progress.png, download-receipt.json and verified-download.bin prove completed 32MiB save.

evidence.requirement: Fullscreen reste dans le dock avec origine et sortie Échap ; menus/IME ne recouvrent pas les protections GPUI.
evidence.entry_point: CEF fullscreen -> dock origin notice -> Escape; menu clamp and input routes
evidence.proof: fullscreen-dock.png with Escape exit; menu geometry checks and existing EP-003 IME path preserved.

evidence.requirement: Échec : sélection annulée, popup sans geste, transfert interrompu ou document fermé n’expose aucun fichier supplémentaire et n’exécute rien automatiquement.
evidence.entry_point: OS picker cancel / document close -> scoped transfer cancellation; popup gesture gate
evidence.proof: Native upload/download picker cancellation; document_close_clears_permissions_fullscreen_and_all_transfers, bounded transfer and drop ACK tests. No auto execution or extra files.
